name: AI Reply Enhanced
description: Generate email replies via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Supports style presets, follow-up rewrites, API key pool with smart retry, and auto language-matching.

options.label: API Key
options.description: API key for the endpoint (stored in keychain). Leave empty to use API Key File or AI_REPLY_API_KEY env var.

options.label: API Key File
options.description: Path to a file containing the API key (first non-empty line is used). Recommended over storing the key in PopClip preferences.

options.label: Endpoint Preset
options.description: Choose a preset endpoint or select Custom to enter your own.

options.label: Custom Endpoint
options.description: Required when Endpoint Preset is Custom. Base URL for an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint. No trailing slash.

options.label: API Key Pool File
options.description: Optional. JSON file of [{"api_key":"...","endpoint":"..."}, ...]. Edit this path in Settings; when non-empty, 429/5xx errors retry on a different key.

options.label: API Key Pool (inline)
options.description: Optional fallback managed in Settings. Same JSON shape as the pool file, pasted inline. The pool file takes priority when set.

options.label: Model
options.description: Pick from the list, or choose '🛠 Custom' and type any model id in Custom Model.

options.label: Custom Model
options.description: Used only when Model is set to '🛠 Custom'. Type any model id (e.g. claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022).

options.label: 🌐 Reply in Source Language
options.description: Instruct the model to reply in the same language as the original email.

options.label: ✨ Default Style
options.description: Default reply style used by AI Reply and Follow Up. Change this in Settings instead of choosing style every time.

options.label: 🏷️ Show Language Badge
options.description: Display the detected language in the result dialog.

options.label: 📬 Mail.app Thread Context
options.description: When Mail.app is frontmost and no text is selected, automatically fetch the current email thread. Requires Accessibility permission for PopClip/Terminal.

options.label: 📬 Max Thread Messages
options.description: Maximum number of thread messages to include as context (1–20). Older messages beyond this limit are ignored.

options.label: 🗂️ Save History
options.description: Append each successful generation to ~/Library/Logs/AIReplyPopClip/history.jsonl. History may contain email content and is stored with 600 permissions.
